_meta.harness: evals/real_tasks.py (12 task shapes mirroring the official 41-example learning path)
_meta.referee: laya SDK 0.4.12 verified bit-identical to the checkpoint-era rl_agent_api.py on these inputs - all residual diffs are laya-burn's documented rel-2e-4 float noise on near-tie noul/score answers
found_real_bugs: noul criteria arms dropped: official render_options honors per-question true/false criteria descriptions (laya.email_questions() etc); the port always used the fixed arms - fixed in jev.rs

compact state serialization: dict/list states were serialized with serde's compact form ({"body":"..."}) instead of Python json.dumps separators ({"body": "..."}) - token streams diverged on EVERY dict-state request; fixed in jev.rs parse_request via PythonJson::state

_meta.q8_result: 4/12 at first run was a harness key-mismatch artifact (rendered vs bare probability keys) plus Q8-vs-f32 noise; after the two bug fixes the Q8 deployment path serves the same answers as f32 within quantization noise
_meta.robustness: 16-way concurrency: 16/16 OK in 9.9s wall, all answers identical; malformed requests (no state / 1-option choice / bad type / empty body) all clean 400s; zh state routes multilingual, en routes english
